A little collection of moments

Unforgettable Memories

✧ ♡ ✧

Jaya,
nee enakku kudutha memories ennaala marakka mudiyathu. Sila moments chinna vishayama irunthalum, adhu enakku romba special. Un kooda share panna sirippu, pesina neram, andha memories ellame en manasula eppovume irukkum.

Un kooda time spend pannadhu, en manasula irukkura vishayangalai un kitta share pannadhu, oru naal un kooda travel pannadhu — indha moments ellame enakku romba special. Andha naal en life-la marakka mudiyadha oru beautiful day. En vazhkaila first time bangles vaangi kuduthadhu unakkuthaan; andha chinna gift-um, adhu kooda irukkura ninaivugalum enakku eppovume special-ah irukkum.

Indha unforgettable memories ellathayum enakku kuduthathukku romba thanks. Thank you for everything. 🌸
